p=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-medium-fresh0/frozen/held-out-reference-3/play/users/u046/system/state/workspace/programs/task-25c26da1.py')

source='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    points = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v == 2]
    rows = {}
    for r, c in points:
        rows.setdefault(r, []).append(c)
    # The row containing the two horizontally paired markers is the main axis.
    axis = next(r for r, cols in rows.items() if len(cols) >= 2)
    cols = rows[axis]
    for c in range(min(cols), max(cols) + 1):
        if out[axis][c] == 0:
            out[axis][c] = 3
    for r, c in points:
        if r == axis:
            continue
        step = 1 if axis > r else -1
        for rr in range(r + step, axis, step):
            if out[rr][c] == 0:
                out[rr][c] = 3
    return out
'''
